LanguageData.LP_CloudGiant.label: cloud giant
LanguageData.LP_CloudGiant.description: A giant race that lives in castles in the clouds; the bloodline is passed on to children. Adult cloud giants are 2.2 times the size of an ordinary person, with pale blue-white skin and cloud circlets on silver-white hair. They walk as if on clouds; marsh, mud, shallow water and snow can't slow them, and even traps can't sense their steps. Cloud giants care about dignity and will only live in bedrooms befitting their status, yet they are generous hosts who like to make friends with gifts; they speak elegantly and excel at negotiation and persuasion. In the giant ordning, cloud giants rank second only to storm giants.
LanguageData.LP_CloudGiant.descriptionShort: Inheritable giant race (rank 2 of the ordning). 2.2× giant body, cloud step (no slowdown in marsh, mud, shallow water, snow), doesn't trigger traps, outstanding social skills, particular about bedrooms, gives gifts; Misty Step, Fog Cloud, Call Wind.
